title: Positive Test: LTE Initial Attach and Detach Procedure Success
description: Validate successful LTE attach and detach procedure with a single UE under excellent radio conditions as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.8.2.1.
preconditions: Single cell scenario activated with no inter-cell interference
Stationary UE placed under excellent LTE RSRP conditions
All other cells powered off
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup with specified LTE parameters
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE and wait for successful attach to LTE cell
Verify UE is attached to correct cell via UE logs (checking PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)
Power OFF the UE and wait for successful detach from LTE network
Validate signaling connection release messages (UE context release and RRC connection release)
Stop and save the logs
Repeat attach-detach cycle 10 times
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
Detach success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
Attach latency measured and logged (Min, Average, Max)
All procedures follow 3GPP TS 23.401 specifications
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach/detach success
Check signaling message sequence in logs
Calculate attach latency for each iteration

title: Positive Test: 5G NSA Attach and Secondary Node Addition
description: Validate successful 5G NSA attach and secondary node addition as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1.
preconditions: Single cell scenario activated with no inter-cell interference
Stationary UE placed under excellent 5G SS-RSRP conditions
All other cells powered off
Test configuration recorded for LTE and 5G cell parameters
testSteps: Configure test setup with LTE and 5G NSA parameters
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE and wait for successful LTE attach and 5G secondary node addition
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cell via UE logs (PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN)
Validate SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages
Power OFF the UE and wait for successful detach and secondary node release
Validate detach request, detach accept, and secondary node release signaling
Stop and save the logs
Repeat attach-detach cycle 10 times
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
Secondary node addition success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
Detach success rate is 100% for 10 iterations
All procedures comply with referenced 3GPP specifications
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach, secondary node addition and detach success
Check signaling message sequence for SgNB addition and release
Confirm correct cell parameters in UE logs

title: Negative Test: Attach Failure under Poor Radio Conditions
description: Verify system behavior and error handling when UE attempts LTE or 5G NSA attach under poor radio conditions (below minimum coupling loss).
preconditions: Single cell scenario activated
UE placed under degraded LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP conditions below minimum coupling loss
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup with degraded radio conditions
Start logging call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE and attempt to attach to LTE or 5G NSA cell
Monitor attach request and response messages
Power OFF the UE to attempt detach procedure
Stop and save the logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out as expected due to poor radio conditions
Detach procedure either not initiated or fails gracefully
Error or failure messages logged and captured
System maintains stability without crashes
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach failure messages or timeouts
Validate correct error handling and signaling
Check no unexpected system behavior occurs

title: Edge Case: Attach/Detach with UE at Minimum Coupling Loss Boundary
description: Verify attach and detach success when the UE is placed exactly at the minimum coupling loss threshold defined for excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell scenario activated
UE placed exactly at minimum coupling loss threshold
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup to achieve exact minimum coupling loss
Start logging
Power ON UE and wait for attach success
Power OFF UE and wait for detach success
Repeat for 10 iterations
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100%
Latency and KPI values within acceptable range
No intermittent failures
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for success confirmation
Measure latency and compare with targets
Verify radio parameters at boundary

title: Performance Test: Attach and Detach Latency Measurement Over 10 Iterations
description: Measure and analyze attach latency (min, average, max) and success rates for LTE and 5G NSA attach-detach procedures in excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell scenario activated with excellent radio conditions
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: For each iteration from 1 to 10:
Start logging
Power ON UE and record attach request and attach complete timestamps
Power OFF UE and wait for successful detach
Stop logging
Calculate attach latency (attach complete - attach request)
Record success/failure for attach and detach
After 10 iterations, calculate min, average, and max latency
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100%
Attach latency is within expected target as per test requirements
Latency statistics (min, avg, max) are correctly calculated and logged
verificationMethods: Timestamp analysis from logs
Statistical calculation of latency
Success rate validation from signaling messages

title: Negative Test: Secondary Node Release Rejection by SN
description: Simulate scenario where Secondary Node (SN) rejects the SN Release request due to ongoing SN change procedure and verify system handling.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN configured
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: MN initiates Secondary Node Release by sending SgNB Release Request
SN rejects the request due to SN change procedure trigger
Verify that MN correctly handles rejection
Verify signaling flow continues without errors or deadlocks
Ensure UE continues connected state or fallback as per specifications
expectedResults: SN sends SgNB Release Request Acknowledge with rejection indication
MN handles rejection gracefully without crashes
No loss of UE connectivity unless specified by procedure
Logs capture the rejection and handling
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling messages for rejection indication
Check MN state machine and error handling logs
Validate UE connectivity status post rejection

title: Integration Test: Coordination Between MN and SN for Data Forwarding During Secondary Node Release
description: Validate the coordination and timing of data forwarding and signaling message exchange between MN and SN during Secondary Node Release procedure.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN configured
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Initiate MN-initiated SN Release procedure
Verify MN sends SgNB Release Request with data forwarding addresses
Verify SN sends SgNB Release Request Acknowledge
Check timing of SN Status Transfer message and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report
Verify data forwarding starts appropriately
Verify UE receives RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to release SCG
Repeat with SN-initiated SN Release and verify equivalent steps
expectedResults: Data forwarding and signaling messages are coordinated with no gaps
SN sends Secondary RAT Data Usage Report correctly, possibly before or after data forwarding starts
UE releases SCG configuration successfully
No data loss or service gaps observed
verificationMethods: Analyze timing and order of signaling messages in logs
Check data forwarding start and end timestamps
Verify UE configuration state changes

title: Usability Test: Clarity and Completeness of Test Configuration Recording
description: Verify that the test configuration parameters used for the attach-detach test are clearly recorded and easily retrievable in the test report.
preconditions: Test configuration is applied to test setup
testSteps: Perform attach-detach test according to documentation
Ensure all relevant parameters (PCI, Global eNB/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN, radio conditions) are recorded
Generate test report including the recorded configuration
Review report for clarity, completeness, and accessibility of configuration data
expectedResults: Test configuration parameters are fully documented in the report
Parameters are clearly labeled and easy to understand
No missing or ambiguous configuration data
verificationMethods: Manual review of test report content
Cross-check recorded configuration with applied setup

title: Compatibility Test: Attach and Detach Procedure Across Different UE Emulators and Real Devices
description: Verify that the attach and detach procedures perform consistently across different UE implementations (real UE vs. emulated UE).
preconditions: Test configuration recorded
Access to multiple UE types (emulators and real devices)
testSteps: Set up single cell scenario with excellent radio conditions
Perform attach-detach test with real UE for 10 iterations
Perform attach-detach test with multiple UE emulators for 10 iterations each
Compare attach success rate, detach success rate, and latency metrics across devices
expectedResults: All UE types achieve 100% attach and detach success rates
Latency and KPIs are within acceptable tolerance across devices
No device-specific failures or anomalies observed
verificationMethods: Compare logs and KPIs across UE types
Analyze attach and detach signaling consistency

title: Security Test: Verify Authentication and Authorization During Attach Procedure
description: Validate that the attach procedure enforces proper UE authentication and authorization as per 3GPP specifications during LTE and 5G NSA attach.
preconditions: Single cell scenario activated
UE with valid and invalid credentials available
testSteps: Attempt attach procedure with UE having valid credentials
Verify successful authentication and attach completion
Attempt attach procedure with UE having invalid or revoked credentials
Verify attach rejection or failure with proper authentication failure messages
Check for unauthorized access prevention
expectedResults: Valid UE attaches successfully with proper authentication
Invalid UE attach attempts are rejected
Authentication failure messages are logged
No security breaches or unauthorized access
verificationMethods: Analyze authentication signaling messages
Check security logs for authentication failures
Confirm attach success or failure accordingly

title: Negative Test: UE Inability to Comply with RRCConnectionReconfiguration During SN Release
description: Simulate UE failure in complying with RRCConnectionReconfiguration message during Secondary Node Release and verify reconfiguration failure handling.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN configured
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Initiate SN Release procedure (MN or SN initiated)
MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration to UE to release SCG
UE unable to comply with full or partial configuration in RRCConnectionReconfiguration message
UE performs reconfiguration failure procedure
Verify network handling of UE reconfiguration failure
expectedResults: UE triggers reconfiguration failure procedure as specified
Network detects and handles failure appropriately without service disruption
Logs capture failure and recovery steps
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for reconfiguration failure messages
Validate network response and fallback mechanisms
Check UE state transitions

title: Edge Case: Attach-Detach Procedure with UE at Cell Edge with Variable Attenuator
description: Test attach and detach success and latency when UE is placed at cell edge using variable attenuator or fading generator to simulate marginal radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell activated with variable attenuator/fading generator available
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Set attenuator/fading generator to simulate cell edge radio conditions
Place UE accordingly
Perform attach and detach procedure for 10 iterations
Measure attach success rate, detach success rate, and latency
Record radio parameters (RSRP/SS-RSRP, RSRQ)
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates may be reduced but procedures should handle gracefully
Latency may increase but should not exceed target thresholds significantly
System remains stable without crashes or deadlocks
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for success/failure and latency
Measure radio parameters to confirm cell edge conditions
Check system stability during test

title: Integration Test: Verify Conditional PSCell Change Cancel Procedure During SN Release With Inter-SN CPC
description: Test handling of Conditional PSCell Change Cancel (CPAC) procedure triggered during Secondary Node Release when inter-SN CPC is configured.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with inter-SN CPC configured
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Initiate SN Release procedure (MN or SN initiated)
Upon reception of SgNB Release Request Acknowledge or SgNB Release Required messages, verify MN cancels all CPC with candidate SN(s)
If SN initiated inter-SN CPC, verify MN triggers Conditional PSCell Change Cancel towards source SN
Verify signaling messages associated with CPC cancellation
Confirm UE and network state consistency post cancellation
expectedResults: MN properly cancels CPC configurations as per procedure
Conditional PSCell Change Cancel messages sent when applicable
No inconsistent UE or network states post cancellation
Logs capture CPC cancellation signaling
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling messages for CPC cancellation
Verify MN and UE states in logs
Confirm no residual CPC configurations remain

title: Performance Test: Attach-Detach Procedure Under Load With Multiple Sequential Single UE Tests
description: Measure system stability and KPI consistency when performing consecutive single UE attach-detach tests repeatedly over extended time.
preconditions: Single cell activated with excellent radio conditions
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Perform attach-detach test with a single UE for 10 iterations as baseline
Repeat the 10 iteration attach-detach test sequence 5 times sequentially without system reset
Monitor attach success rate, detach success rate, latency, and resource usage
Observe for any performance degradation or failures
expectedResults: Success rates remain at or near 100% throughout tests
Latency remains stable without significant increase
System resources remain within expected usage thresholds
No crashes or unexpected behavior observed
verificationMethods: Analyze logs and KPI trends over time
Monitor system resource metrics
Validate signaling continuity and absence of errors
